NewsArticle.Title: Heart Quest Effect
NewsArticle.Content: Heart Quest final vision that causes dia naomh aite ionad (room effect) now causes dia naomh aite comlha (group effect). Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
